Buffer computation of transformer The buffer in the RTE that is needed: • for the SOME/IP transformation will be calculated from the length of the ISig- nal that is referencing a transformer chain that includes the SOME/IP Trans- former. • for the ComBased transformation will be calculated from the length of the Pdu that contains the ISignalGroup that is referencing a transformer chain that includes the ComBased Transformer.
